## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/stability/image_generation/transformation.py

Prompts

```
['transform an OpenAI-style image generation request into a Stability AI request format', 'transform a Stability AI response into an OpenAI-compatible ImageResponse object', 'map OpenAI image generation parameters to Stability AI parameters like aspect_ratio', 'validate the Stability API environment and set up authorization headers', 'get the complete Stability AI API endpoint URL for a given model']
```

```
{'transform_image_generation_request': 'transform an OpenAI-style image generation request into a Stability AI request format', 'transform_image_generation_response': 'transform a Stability AI response into an OpenAI-compatible ImageResponse object', 'map_openai_params': 'map OpenAI image generation parameters to Stability AI parameters like aspect_ratio', 'validate_environment': 'validate the Stability API environment and set up authorization headers', 'get_complete_url': 'get the complete Stability AI API endpoint URL for a given model'}
```
